text: 7月进出口高位放缓；美日罕见联手干预日元｜一周热点回顾 其他热点还有：首部针对L3级和L4级系统的强制性国家标准发布；宇树科技发行价确定150.8元，估值超600亿元。
text_en: July exports and imports slow from high levels; US and Japan rare joint intervention in yen | Weekly hot review: Other hot topics include first mandatory national standard for L3 and L4 systems released; Unitree Technology sets IPO price at 150.8 yuan, valuation over 60 billion yuan
